Pemerintah Kabupaten Bogor membutuhkan s: Bogor Regency Government needed a single integrated platform to monitor the attendance, performance, and discipline of thousands of civil servants in real time — while suppressing attendance data manipulation and accelerating staffing administration that was previously manual and scattered across many applications.
Sicantik dibangun sebagai sistem tunggal: Sicantik was built as a single system combining GPS-based attendance with selfie verification and face detection, digital performance management (e-SKP, cascading, action plans, realization, 360° review), civil service administration (leave, official travel, TPP), data-driven discipline enforcement, and leadership dashboards — all in one web & mobile application.
Bogor Corporate University (GORPU) — por: Bogor Corporate University (GORPU) — an LMS & assessment center portal for civil servants: learning rooms, training, coaching & mentoring, assessment data, training archives, up to an Online Assessment Center with face detection and WebRTC live video proctoring.
BKPSDM Kabupaten Bogor membutuhkan satu: BKPSDM of Bogor Regency needed one integrated platform to run ASN competency development digitally (e-learning), an assessment center, and training data management that was previously manual and scattered across many applications — while ensuring the integrity of online exams (OAC) for thousands of participants across agencies that require real-time remote proctoring.
Bogor Corporate University (GORPU) diban: Bogor Corporate University (GORPU) was built as a single LMS & assessment center portal combining learning rooms, training, coaching & mentoring, internships, employee assessment data, an Online Assessment Center with WebRTC (Janus Gateway) live video proctoring, TensorFlow.js face detection, strict exam security (fullscreen lock and tab-switch detection), training archives, JP tabulation, digital certificates, and app content settings — all in one modern web application built on Vue 3 and Laravel.
SIMPEG — sistem informasi kepegawaian te: SIMPEG — BKPSDM of Bogor Regency integrated civil service information system: ASN master data & records, mutation administration, promotions, KGB, pension, disciplinary punishment, formation & job-analysis planning, analytic tabulation, up to SIASN/BKN reconciliation — all in one system.
BKPSDM Kabupaten Bogor membutuhkan satu: BKPSDM of Bogor Regency needed one integrated civil service information system to manage data and services for thousands of civil servants — from master data, rank and position history, mutation administration, promotions, KGB, pension, disciplinary punishment, to workforce planning (job analysis, bezzeting, formation) — previously scattered across many applications, partly manual, and not integrated with SIASN/BKN or other staffing applications such as Sicantik.
SIMPEG dibangun sebagai sistem tunggal k: SIMPEG was built as a single staffing system managing the entire ASN data lifecycle digitally and centrally — with SIASN/BKN data reconciliation and synchronization, exportable analytic tabulation and recaps, workforce planning and job maps, talent & succession management, digital services (E-Sign, Regent Decrees, work agreements), plus dashboards for leadership and regional device operators.
